title: Star Trek Battle Gambit
game_overview: A streamlined top-down sci-fi chess game with full chess rules, local computer AI, volume control, and customizable transparent piece sprites.
winning_condition: Checkmate the enemy Commander Flagship or force the opponent into surrender.
losing_condition: Your Commander Flagship is placed in inescapable checkmate.

controls.action: Select piece or destination square on the board.
Skip active engagement flight and combat animation.
Open in-game tactical settings, theme selector, and engagement profile editor.
Undo the most recent turn move in single-player mode.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Authoritative Chess Rules: Full fidelity standard 8x8 chess adherence (castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate, stalemate, 50-move rule, three-fold repetition). 2. Cinematic Tactical Skirmish: Every piece move glides smoothly across the vacuum; captures initiate high-octane 5-10 second naval engagements with customizable beam and torpedo volleys before claiming territory. 3. Deep Customization & Moddability: Independent faction themes (Generic, Stellar Coalition, Cyber Collective, Obsidian Union, Crimson Legion, Shadow Enclave), editable per-class engagement profiles, and hot-swappable transparent sprite tokens.
sections.summary: Core foundational philosophies of the cosmic starship chess game.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: 1. Evaluate Board: Inspect piece positioning, threat lanes, and legal move indicators. 2. Select & Order: Click/tap a starship piece to display glowing tactical trajectory hexes; select valid destination. 3. Execution: Normal moves trigger smooth warp-glide animation. Captures trigger a dedicated 5-10 second engagement sequence (approach vector, beam/torpedo weapon salvos, shield-break explosion particle VFX, followed by arrival at the destination square). 4. Turn Handover: Local heuristic AI evaluates board position (material + positional heatmaps) and replies. Loop continues until checkmate, draw, or stalemate.
sections.summary: The turn-based tactical loop between human commander and AI.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Authoritative Chess Engine: Complete rulebook validation with move generation, in-check calculation, king path verification, en passant capture flags, and queen/rook/bishop/knight promotion selector modals. 2. Engagement Profile Engine: Per-class engagement timing (approach speed, standoff distance, weapon salvo count, beam color, torpedo frequency, explosion radius). Captures are legally guaranteed with no RNG or hit-point attrition. 3. Theme & Asset Replacement System: Independent White/Black side selectors supporting 6 distinct faction themes. Replacing one class asset instantly propagates to all matching pieces of that theme. Procedural SVG/Canvas fallbacks guarantee 100% visual uptime. 4. Animation Decoupling: Authoritative game state updates cleanly while animation runners handle visual playback with instant skip capability.
sections.summary: Game systems, rule enforcement, and modular starship profiles.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Multi-Directional / Static Viewport (Zero scrolling). The 8x8 galactic grid fills the primary visual canvas. Asset Orientation: Overhead planar orientation with ships facing forward (3 o'clock / East by default) and rotating via smooth atan2 angular interpolation towards flight vectors and target defenders during battle engagements. Movement Physics: Smooth ease-in-out cubic bezier interpolation for standard flight; orbital circling and standoff deceleration during battle skirmishes.
sections.summary: Fixed overhead spatial perspective and vector flight kinetics.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer 1 (Background): Deep celestial space nebula backdrop with twinkling stars and subtle dust motes. Layer 2 (Grid Plane): Subtle translucent grid lines and coordinate labels (A-H, 1-8) with zero opaque square fills, ensuring the starfield remains visible. Layer 3 (Highlights): Pulsing cyan targeting rings for legal moves, gold rings for selected ships, and crimson warning glows for checks. Layer 4 (Fleet Entities): High-contrast ship tokens with colored faction rings and rank insignia. Layer 5 (VFX / Weapon Salvos): High-luminance reddish-orange energy lances, red plasma torpedoes, whitish-blue quantum torpedoes, and multi-particle explosions.
sections.summary: Layer plane separation and tactical clarity.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: 1. Pawn (Scout Corvette): Light, agile vanguard craft. 2. Knight (Interceptor Destroyer): Maneuverable flanking ship capable of hyper-jumping over obstacles. 3. Bishop (Cruiser Frigate): Long-range diagonal battery frigate. 4. Rook (Heavy Battlecruiser): Orthogonal dreadnought with heavy defensive bulk. 5. Queen (Armada Flagship): High-speed devastating capital warship dominating broad spatial lanes. 6. King (Command Citadel / Command Ship): Vital planetary command dreadnought whose fall concludes the campaign.
sections.summary: The six standard piece ranks transformed into armada classes.

sections.title: Starship Battle Animation & Engagement Profiles
sections.content: When a capture occurs: 1. Approach: Attacker accelerates towards the defender, stopping at standoff range. 2. Salvo Sequence: Attacker aligns forward weapons and fires alternating reddish-orange pulse beams, red torpedoes, and whitish-blue quantum torpedoes. 3. Impact & Detonation: Defender flashes, emits plasma flare arcs, and explodes into glowing debris fragments with a cosmic shockwave ring. 4. Re-position: Attacker glides forward and locks onto the contested coordinate. A prominent 'Skip Animation' button or Spacebar press instantly concludes the battle sequence and updates the board.
sections.summary: 5-10 second battle skirmish system and customizable weapon behaviors.

sections.title: Fairness Tools & AI System
sections.content: 1. Legal Move Radar: Highlighting valid moves, capture targets, and castling routes. 2. Threat & Check Indicators: Clear visual beacon on the king when in check. 3. Move History & PGN Log: Scrollable tactical notation sheet with undo/redo controls. 4. Local AI Opponent: Multi-tier heuristic evaluation (material balance, piece-square tables, pawn structure, king safety) running purely in local browser memory without network calls.
sections.summary: Player assistance overlays and heuristic local chess opponent.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Starships power up thrusters with glowing particle plumes upon selection. State Change Juice: Trajectory vector lines preview the planned route; board coordinate letters illuminate on hover. Impact Juice: Screen shake on torpedo detonations, radial shockwave rings, lingering wreckage motes, and crisp synthesized sci-fi sound effects for weapon discharges and warp drives.
sections.summary: Visual feedback, audio effects, and cosmetic impact.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for chess enthusiasts, sci-fi strategy gamers, and tactical tabletop fans. Supports Single-Player vs Local AI (Easy, Medium, Hard) as well as Pass-and-Play Local 2-Player mode.

sections.title: Accessibility & Save System
sections.content: High-contrast board outlines, text labels alongside ship icons, animation speed sliders (Instant, Fast, Cinematic), and full keyboard navigation. LocalStorage auto-saves game state, faction theme preferences, and custom engagement profiles across browser sessions.
sections.summary: Inclusive interface and persistent game state.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Vite + React + TypeScript single-page application. Authoritative pure TypeScript chess rulebook engine cleanly decoupled from React view components and Canvas animation overlays. LocalStorage profile management for hot-swappable asset URLs and weapon timing curves.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Fully responsive 8x8 touch grid mapping with touch-none on interactive canvas elements, large tactile control buttons for Skip Animation, Undo, Settings, and Side Selection modals. Absolute positioned action bars with pointer-events-auto strictly on button elements.
sections.summary: Mobile touch support and responsive UI overlay.
